core.scope: Full ExViewerCore package suite, rerun before publication

native.scope: SearchRequestContractTests, GalleryPagerTests and DiscoveryNavigationTests, rerun in a temporary iOS27.0 simulator

UI.scope: Four library scope positions and outer frame, Add/Common tag behavior, detail-tag search actions; latest applicable result per case
UI.prior_failed_selector: Resolved by querying the actual Button accessibility label; application runtime unchanged

limitations: UI tests use isolated neutral fixtures; real account playback, network performance and financial actions are not accepted by these tests.
Historical UI tests can describe superseded interactions; use selectors appropriate to the current behavior.
Live global rating ordering is not implemented; online results keep site order.
